notes.title: Casinopia Update Note (2017.10.24)
notes.content:
Greetings all,

Today we have an update for the game. We made some improvement and fixed a few bugs.

Update:
- Fixed a bug that caused MENU button stopped working.
- Fixed a bug where you could not close the Gold Shop window.
- Improvements on the game's ease of use/convenience.

Thank you! :)
